Just over six years ago, I found something unusual in the data for the closest match to the pandemic virus SARS-CoV-2. Soon after the pandemic began, the Wuhan Institute of Virology published RaTG13, having previously called it BtCoV/4991 in a short sequence published pre-pandemic. Strangely, 6/33 published reads of RaTG13 were labeled "7896", the name of a different betacoronavirus kept in the Wuhan lab. Why would the lab, known for splicing different viruses together, name part of one virus after another? Naturally, I wondered if RaTG13 was actually a composite virus of the original BtCoV/4991 and 7896. I shared the finding in the Drastic group chat and we investigated it, with @franciscodeasis then publicly alerting @Ayjchan to the dates in the amplicon sequences, who then mapped out the lab's work progress with RaTG13 before the pandemic. The Wuhan lab has since released a virus they claimed to be the original 7896. The parts of RaTG13 labeled 7896 are a close match to the published 7896 virus, but not quite it. So what did they publish? Another virus? Another composite? Splicing viruses together and then testing how well the composite viruses bind to human cells was exactly what the lab did (See this summary from 2021: zenodo.org/records/21704910). But the 7896 parts of RaTG13 may not be from a different virus spliced together. If we take them at face value, the lab appears to have been using 7896 as part of the sequencing process, a sort of reference point to amplify and see what they were looking at in RaTG13. According to the lab, they started using new sequencing equipment in 2018 so would not have had to do that any more, but these were dated June 2017. The six RaTG13 7896 sequences cover the area around the RdRp and are labeled 1, 2 and 4. The area which would have been 3 is where the already published short BtCoV/4991 RdRp sequence should be, so it looks like they started with that then expanded coverage using parts of what they already had from 7896. This tells us about their pre-pandemic workstream. As some of the published RdRp sequences of the group of viruses including 7896 are identical, the Wuhan lab must have had longer sequences from them to be able to tell them apart. It tells us that the lab was working on some of the most similar viruses to the pandemic one as a group before the pandemic, using parts of their research into one to inform research into another. And why were they doing this work in the run up to the pandemic? The latest date in the RaTG13 amplicon sequences was only 11 weeks before a project testing human ACE2 receptor binding of two novel bat SARS-related coronaviruses was due to begin in January 2019. Was the work in preparation for that?

কাদিয়ানী সম্প্রদায়কে রাষ্ট্রীয়ভাবে অমুসলিম ঘোষণা এবং তাদের বই-পুস্তক নিষিদ্ধের দাবিতে আগামী ১৫ আগস্ট আয়োজিত জাতীয় ওলামা-মাশায়েখ সম্মেলন সফল করতে সর্বস্তরের ওলামায়ে কেরাম ও তাওহিদি জনতার প্রতি আহ্বান জানায় আন্তর্জাতিক মজলিসে তাহাফফুজে খতমে নবুওয়ত বাংলাদেশ। সোমবার (৩ আগস্ট) রাজধানীর উত্তরার জামিয়াতুল মানহাল মাদরাসায় ঢাকা মহানগর উত্তরা জোনের উদ্যোগে এক মতবিনিময় সভা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। সংগঠনের কেন্দ্রীয় সহ-সভাপতি হাফেজ মাওলানা নাজমুল হাসান কাসেমীর সভাপতিত্বে এবং যুগ্ম মহাসচিব মুফতি কিফায়েতুল্লাহ আজহারীর সঞ্চালনায় সভায় প্রধান অতিথি ছিলেন মহাসচিব মাওলানা মুহিউদ্দিন রাব্বানী। প্রধান অতিথির বক্তব্যে মাওলানা মুহিউদ্দিন রাব্বানী বলেন, খতমে নবুওয়তের আকিদা সংরক্ষণ এবং কাদিয়ানিদের কার্যক্রম প্রতিরোধের দাবিতে আগামী ১৫ আগস্ট রাজধানীর রমনায় ইঞ্জিনিয়ার্স ইনস্টিটিউশন, বাংলাদেশ (আইইবি)-এ জাতীয় ওলামা-মাশায়েখ সম্মেলন অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। সম্মেলন শুরু হবে দুপুর ২টায়। তিনি দেশব্যাপী ওলামায়ে কেরাম ও ধর্মপ্রাণ মুসলমানদের স্বতঃস্ফূর্ত অংশগ্রহণের আহ্বান জানান। সভাপতির বক্তব্যে হাফেজ মাওলানা নাজমুল হাসান কাসেমী বলেন, উত্তরার আলেমদের ঐক্য ও সহযোগিতা ১৫ আগস্টের সম্মেলনকে সফল করবে বলে তিনি আশাবাদী। সভায় বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে বক্তব্য দেন মাওলানা আহমদ আলী কাসেমী, মাওলানা মুজিবুর রহমান হামিদী, মাওলানা আব্দুল কাইয়ুম ইসলামবাগ, মাওলানা রাশিদ বিন নূর ও মাওলানা নজিরুল ইসলাম। #UlamaConference #Dhaka #ReligiousEvent #somoytv

We have launched the Carpathian Initiative track. This is a new initiative. Why did this idea emerge? Because not all countries are ready to strengthen us with weapons, but they do want to stand with us on the humanitarian and security tracks and in the economic sphere. They are thinking about Ukraine’s recovery. This is also important. When neighboring countries think about recovery, it also reflects their faith in Ukraine – their belief that peace will come. And we will have peace. This is also an important signal. The Carpathian Initiative brings together countries connected not only geopolitically and as neighbors. These are countries with shared economic and security interests, united by the beautiful Carpathian Mountains. It is about logistics, the economy, and security. We also saw culture and future tourism as part of it. I presented this idea to the Presidents of the European Council and the European Commission. They liked it very much. We will launch this format in the fall. We are now discussing the dates. We have received a positive signal from the European Union. In the future, we will need programs for the Carpathians – covering funding, tourism, the economy, and security. And again, this is not only about the Ukrainian Carpathians. It includes Ukraine, Romania, Austria, Serbia, Hungary, Poland, Czechia, and Slovakia. This initiative is something around which all of us can unite. We need it. Israel has leaped to No. 2 on The Economist’s Big Mac Index, a list that ranks the relative cost of the McDonald’s burger across the world from most expensive to least expensive. Israel ranked No. 8 on the list in January, but jumped six spots to have the second most expensive Big Mac, following only Switzerland. Coming 2nd in the index does not mean that The Economist is indicating Israel is the world’s 2nd most expensive country. The index, which it has published for 40 years, does provide an insight into relative purchasing power, however, since in theory, the Big Mac should cost more or less the same worldwide. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्र पीजीआय 2.0 मध्ये देशात दुसऱ्या स्थानावर कायम आहे. राज्यात पीएम श्री शाळांसह सर्व शाळांमधून चांगले शिक्षण दिले जात आहे. यावेळी शिक्षण क्षेत्रात अभिनव उपक्रमांची अंमलबजावणी करावी. राज्यातील विद्यार्थ्यांचे शालेय आधार प्रमाणीकरण, RTEद्वारे 35 लाख विद्यार्थ्यांना शैक्षणिक सुविधांचा लाभ, पवित्र पोर्टल, राष्ट्रीय शिक्षण धोरणाची अंमलबजावणी यांसह विविध शैक्षणिक उपक्रमांची माहिती मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी घेतली. राज्य शासनाने शाळांमध्ये नशाविरोधी मार्गदर्शक व समुपदेशन समित्या स्थापन करण्याचा आणि 'ड्रग-फ्री स्कूल' अभियान राबवण्याचा मोठा निर्णय घेतला आहे. शाळांमधील सुरक्षा, सायबर फसवणूक आणि अमली पदार्थ प्रतिबंधासाठी प्रभावी व कठोर उपाययोजना राबविण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. राज्यातील विद्यार्थी-शिक्षक प्रमाण 28 : 1 देशातील एकूण शाळांपैकी 9.34 टक्के, शिक्षकांपैकी 8.84 टक्के आणि विद्यार्थ्यांपैकी 7.69 टक्के वाटा महाराष्ट्राचा आहे. राज्यातील एकूण 1,08,065 शाळांमध्ये 2,20,48,443 विद्यार्थी शिक्षण घेत असून, विद्यार्थी-शिक्षक प्रमाण 28 : 1 आहे. राज्यातील शाळांमध्ये 64,341 शासकीय, 29,486 खासगी अनुदानित आणि उर्वरित स्वयंअर्थसहाय्यित तसेच केंद्रीय शाळा आहेत. शालेय शिक्षण व्यवस्थेचा विस्तार आणि गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षणासाठी राज्य शासन विविध स्तरांवर सुधारणा राबवत आहे. निपुण महाराष्ट्र अभियान, राष्ट्र प्रथम अभियान, मुख्यमंत्री माझी शाळा सुंदर शाळा यांसारख्या उपक्रमांबाबत, विद्यार्थ्यांना शाळेमध्ये आणण्यासाठी, शाळा प्रवेशोत्सवासारखे कार्यक्रम याबद्दल यावेळी माहिती देण्यात आली. शिक्षकांसाठी AI साथीच्या माध्यमातून ऑनलाइन प्रशिक्षणदेखील राबविण्यात आले आहे. शिक्षकांचे अभ्यास दौरे, चांगले काम करणाऱ्या शिक्षण समित्या व शिक्षकांच्या सहभागाने उपक्रमांना चालना, दत्तक शाळा, CSR-सामंजस्य कराराच्या माध्यमातून शिक्षण क्षेत्रात नवीन विचारदेखील सुरू झाला आहे. यातूनच शासकीय शाळांमध्ये 'Super 100' योजना राबविण्यात येत आहे. यामध्ये प्रत्येक जिल्ह्यातील ग्रामीण भागातील गुणवान 100 विद्यार्थ्यांची NEET, JEE परीक्षांचे स्पर्धात्मक व चांगल्या दर्जाचे प्रशिक्षण देण्यासाठी निवड केली जाईल. राज्य शासनाच्या प्रयत्नामुळे महाराष्ट्राचे आराध्यदैवत छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज यांच्या गौरवशाली इतिहासाला केंद्र सरकारच्या वतीने NCERTच्या पाठ्यपुस्तकात विस्तृत स्थान देण्यात आले आहे. Maharashtra has removed more than 92 lakh women from the Ladki Bahin scheme, the Rs 1,500 monthly transfer it launched three months before the 2024 election and won a 230-seat sweep on. The list is now 38 per cent below its peak of 2.43 crore. The allocation has come down from about Rs 36,000 crore to Rs 26,000 crore. The reason is money. Maharashtra's finance department puts the fiscal deficit near Rs 1.5 lakh crore against public debt of about Rs 11 lakh crore. Officials estimate the women now removed had already drawn close to Rs 14,000 crore. Even after the cut, the scheme costs about a fifth of everything Maharashtra spends on roads, metros and irrigation put together. The state has reduced its health budget this year. But no government cuts a scheme it won an election on. So they cut the list instead. West Bengal is the clearest case. The BJP campaigned on raising Mamata Banerjee's Lakshmir Bhandar payout, and at its first cabinet meeting nearly doubled it to Rs 3,000. The budget then allocated Rs 36,000 crore, roughly what the old scheme cost. It works because the government expects the number of women receiving it to fall from 2.4 crore to about 1 crore, using the revised electoral rolls to decide who stays. Delhi wrote the same outcome into the eligibility rules. Its new scheme is built to admit just over 17 lakh women out of 71 lakh registered women voters. A family with more than three children, a car, a government employee, an income-tax filing, or electricity use above 2,400 units is excluded. Karnataka has ordered every beneficiary of two schemes to re-apply with fresh biometrics, after finding over Rs 100 crore had gone to dead women and income-tax payers. Jharkhand's scheme costs Rs 14,065 crore, which is more than the state's entire fiscal deficit for the year. The Centre has done it too. PM-KISAN is 16 per cent below its 2021 peak. MGNREGA is 28 per cent down. Not everyone is doing this. Madhya Pradesh has raised its payout and kept its list steady, on a deficit well above the norm. A notable change of command regarding Ukraine. Lieutenant General Curtis Buzzard has served as the Commanding General of Security Assistance Group-Ukraine and NATO Security Assistance & Training for Ukraine since 2024. Admiral Giuseppe CAVO DRAGONE - NATO CMC (@CMC_NATO) Today, at Clay Kaserne in #Wiesbaden 🇩🇪, NATO Security Assistance and Training for #Ukraine changes command. Let me begin with Lieutenant General Curtis Buzzard. He did not inherit a headquarters: he built one. When Allied Leaders decided at the Washington Summit to place our support to Ukraine on an enduring footing, that decision was a solid commitment in a communiqué. Curt turned it into a command: staffed from across the Alliance and beyond it, and operating from day one at the tempo the war demands. He set the imprint. Those who follow will work inside the architecture he designed. On behalf of the whole NATO Military Committee: Bravo Zulu! And good luck for your next endeavour! To Lieutenant General Guillaume Beaurpère: welcome! You take command of a mission that matters. Why does #NSATU matter? Because Russia's unprovoked and brutal war of aggression was, among other things, also a bet on Allied attention spans. NSATU is a key element of our answer to that bet. It replaces improvisation with predictability. For Ukraine, it means planning horizons instead of surprises, donations sequenced, training synchronised, equipment sustained, requirements read directly from the front through Ukrainian officers embedded in the headquarters and at every node. For Allies, it means coherence, accountability and fair burden-sharing. And it supports Ukraine's inherent right of self-defence under Article 51 of the UN Charter. It is also, quietly, a deterrent instrument. Deterrence is not only forces in being; it is demonstrated staying power. A standing NATO command dedicated to Ukraine's defence tells Moscow that time is not a Russian ally. There is a second dividend, and it flows back to us. This war has taught the Alliance more about modern warfare than a decade of exercises could. We imagined the wars of this century as bits and bytes. What we are watching is different: mass and machines together — soldiers, artillery, logistics under fire, married to cheap, fast, tactically decisive solutions, uncrewed systems and applied AI iterating in weeks, not procurement cycles. NSATU sits where that knowledge is generated, and it feeds both our Strategic Commands: @SHAPE_NATO for how we fight, @NATO_ACT for how we change. Ukraine is not only a recipient of Allied support. It is a teacher. The Military Committee has followed this mission since its inception, and will continue to. To the men and women of NSATU, from 30 nations and Ukraine: our Chiefs of Defence see your work. At the same time, Russian enterprises that manufacture ballistic missiles are still not subject to strict global sanctions. Some key Russian enterprises involved in ballistic missile production are not under sanctions imposed by the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, Switzerland, and other jurisdictions. Of the seventeen key Russian enterprises involved in producing ballistic missiles, most, unfortunately, can exploit sanctions loops in the jurisdictions of various partners. We need greater coordination, daily engagement with partners on sanctions, and greater synchronization of sanctions. Unfortunately, one of the worst consequences of Russia’s war against Ukraine – and of Iran’s tactics as well – is that potential aggressors around the world can see how much harm ballistic missiles can inflict on human life. The global ballistic missile threat will therefore continue to grow, and all anti-ballistic defense capabilities must grow as well. And we already have agreements in place with all of these companies and all the necessary countries. These are the ten countries participating in the Anti-Ballistic Coalition: Ukraine, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden, and the United Kingdom – as well as twelve manufacturers that have already joined. The Anti-Ballistic Coalition and the FREYJA project are open to other participants capable of making a genuine contribution to security across Europe. Often disagree with Andrew on Israel, but he talks a whole lot of sense here Andrew Fox (@Mr_Andrew_Fox) Someone has to do it, so I will. This policy is holed below the waterline before it begins. Zia Yusuf wants Britain’s warships to push migrant boats back to France. There are only three small problems: the law, the French and the Royal Navy. Operation Fortress will be “the largest military operation in the English Channel since World War Two”. Nigel Farage will grandiosely order “his Majesty’s Royal Navy” to intercept every unauthorised vessel crossing the Channel and return its occupants to France. No one arriving illegally will reach Britain. The border will become “impenetrable”. The invasion will be stopped. It sounds magnificent, provided you know nothing about ships, sailors, France or the law. The first clue lies in the name. Operation Fortress sounds like the title of a 1960s war film. Once the bunting has been cleared away, this new policy amounts to parking a few warships in the Channel and instructing them to make the small boats go backwards. Nobody appears to have asked what happens when they do not. An overloaded inflatable carrying 60 or 70 people is rather different to a French fishing trawler whose skipper can be ordered to head for Calais. It may have insufficient fuel, an inadequate engine, and no one aboard capable of navigating it safely. The smugglers may have left the controls in the hands of one of the passengers. The boat may already be leaking, listing, or taking on water. A Royal Navy officer cannot order an inflatable to become seaworthy. The Navy cannot legally fire across its bow. This is a border control operation, not a war. There may not even be enough bow to fire across. HMS Cottrell cannot ram the boat, create a wash beside it or undertake aggressive manoeuvres without risking a capsize. Sending a boarding party alongside an overcrowded dinghy creates another opportunity for dozens of frightened people to shift their weight at once and end up in the water. The moment the boat becomes unsafe, Nigel's great military operation turns into a rescue mission. British sailors are legally required to save those aboard. The obligation arises under the law of the sea, the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea and the International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue. None of these contains a Zia Yusuf exemption. After rescuing the passengers, the Navy must take them to a place of safety. Reform says that place will be France. France may have something to say about that. Britain cannot sail warships into French territorial waters, seize boats, or disembark passengers in Calais without French permission. Nor can it deposit 70 people at the maritime boundary and invite them to swim the remaining distance. Returning them to France requires the French government to accept them. This is the gap at the centre of the policy. A Reform government can give orders to the Royal Navy; it cannot give orders to Emmanuel Macron. There is already a UK-France returns agreement. It permits selected small-boat arrivals to be returned after they reach Britain, in exchange for Britain accepting an equivalent number via a legal route. The arrangement exists because France’s consent is required. It is limited, negotiated and reciprocal. Nothing in it authorises the Royal Navy to deliver every intercepted passenger to a French port. Perhaps Reform has secretly negotiated a much broader agreement with Paris. Perhaps Macron has promised Farage that France will accept tens of thousands of people in exchange for nothing. Perhaps the French will also provide a complimentary cheese board. The details, we are told, will be revealed today. Without French agreement, the Navy will intercept the boats, rescue their occupants, and bring them to Britain. Reform’s answer to the “free ferry service” is to paint the ferry grey and staff it with sailors. The legal problems persist after rescue. Once British forces exercise effective control over a boat or take its passengers aboard, those people fall within British jurisdiction. They cannot all be summarily expelled without any examination of their circumstances. France is a safe country, and there is no general legal prohibition on returning an asylum seeker there. However, any return must still take place under a lawful arrangement. Officials would need to identify children, trafficking victims, those requiring medical treatment, and anyone presenting a specific reason why return would expose them to serious harm. Roughly one in seven small boat arrivals since 2018 has been referred to the National Referral Mechanism as a possible victim of modern slavery. Among those who arrived in 2025, the eventual figure reached 19 per cent. Those cases cannot be resolved by a sub-lieutenant circling boxes on a clipboard while HMS Harborne bobs around somewhere off Dungeness. The European Court of Human Rights has already held that intercepting migrants at sea does not create a legal black hole. In Hirsi Jamaa v Italy, Italy was found to have violated the European Convention by returning intercepted migrants without considering their individual circumstances. In that case, the destination was Libya, so it does not establish that returning to France would be unlawful. It does establish that a government cannot evade its obligations by processing the entire group under the legal category of “off you go”. Reform might respond that it intends to leave the European Convention. That still leaves the Refugee Convention, maritime rescue law, France’s sovereignty, and the stubborn tendency of drowning people to require rescue. A press conference cannot repeal the sea. Then there is the Royal Navy itself. Britain possessed 32 frigates and destroyers in 2000. By October 2025, it had 14. Several of those were undergoing maintenance or preparing for operations. The Navy is also attempting to sustain the nuclear deterrent, protect two aircraft carriers, patrol the North Atlantic, support NATO, guard undersea infrastructure, maintain overseas deployments, and prepare for a possible war with a serious state adversary. Amid this crowded programme, Zia Yusuf demands the largest Channel operation since 1945. A Type 45 destroyer is a £1 billion air-defence platform designed to protect a carrier group against missiles and aircraft. It carries sophisticated radar, anti-aircraft weapons and a crew of nearly 200. Using one to chase inflatables off Dover would be rather like sending a new Challenger 3 tank to enforce parking restrictions outside Lidl. The Type 23 frigates are old, scarce and already stretched. The River-class offshore patrol vessels are better suited to maritime security, but the newer ships have global commitments, while the older ones perform fisheries protection, patrol and training tasks. Moving them into the Channel simply leaves gaps elsewhere. Border Force operates five cutters, six coastal patrol vessels and a range of smaller craft. These are the vessels designed for customs and immigration enforcement. Even that fleet cannot create an impermeable cordon while covering Britain’s other maritime borders. The Channel is one of the busiest shipping routes on earth, not a village pond across which the Royal Navy can stretch a chain. Ships also require crews. As of April 2026, the Royal Navy and UK Marines had 32,520 regular personnel, of whom 4,580 were untrained. Recruitment has begun to improve, but the Navy remains critically short of experienced technicians, engineers and specialists. Some vessels have been alongside for extended periods because the service lacks the trained personnel to operate them. A continuous patrol requires several crews for each vessel on station. One crew is at sea, while others are training, recovering, taking leave or preparing the ship. Each interception requires qualified boat crews, boarding parties, medics, communications staff and command support. If people are brought aboard, the ship also needs space, food, sanitation, interpreters and safeguarding personnel. Warships do not come with infinite sailors. The smugglers would adapt before the first triumphant press release had even finished circulating. They would overload boats until turning them around became impossibly dangerous. Engines would “fail” as British vessels approached. Passengers would be instructed to call for rescue, enter the water, or threaten self-harm. Several boats would launch simultaneously during brief windows of good weather. The absolute promise that nobody will reach Britain creates an incentive to treat every encounter as a humanitarian emergency. The Navy would either rescue those aboard or preside over preventable deaths within sight of its ships. No commanding officer should be placed between his legal duty to save life and a politician’s promise that not one migrant will set foot on British soil. There are serious policy options available. Britain could negotiate broader returns with France, fund aggressive French interception near the beaches, attack the financial and logistical networks behind the crossings, accelerate asylum decisions, remove failed claimants, and build a Border Force fleet capable of sustained maritime enforcement. Joint patrols could operate under an agreement that defines jurisdiction, disembarkation, and responsibility for rescued individuals. Operation Fortress contains none of the difficult parts. France will apparently accept everyone. Every boat will turn around safely. Every legal claim will disappear. The Navy will find spare ships and sailors somewhere in a cupboard in Portsmouth. Declaring the Channel impenetrable will make it so. This is not a serious or credible policy. Operation Fortress is nothing but a press release wearing a sailor’s hat. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Mr_Andrew_Fox/status/2084166393663029610#m

মিয়ানমারের আটক সাবেক নেত্রী অং সান সু চি গত কয়েক বছরের মধ্যে প্রথমবারের মতো কোনো বিদেশি কর্মকর্তার সঙ্গে সাক্ষাৎ করেছেন। সোমবার (৩ আগস্ট) ছবি প্রকাশ করে আন্তর্জাতিক রেডক্রস কমিটির (আইসিআরসি) এক প্রতিনিধির সঙ্গে তাঁর সাক্ষাতের বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করা হয়েছে। দীর্ঘদিন ধরে তার শারীরিক অবস্থা ও অবস্থান নিয়ে উদ্বেগের মধ্যে এই সাক্ষাৎকে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অগ্রগতি হিসেবে দেখা হচ্ছে। ৮১ বছর বয়সি নোবেলজয়ী সু চিকে সম্প্রতি কারাগারের পরিবর্তে গৃহবন্দী করে রাখা হয়। আইসিআরসি জানিয়েছে, তাদের একজন প্রতিনিধি তাঁর সঙ্গে ব্যক্তিগতভাবে কথা বলার সুযোগ পেয়েছেন। আটক ব্যক্তিদের সঙ্গে সাক্ষাতের ক্ষেত্রে সংস্থাটির নির্ধারিত নিয়ম ও প্রক্রিয়া অনুসরণ করেই এই বৈঠক অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে বলে জানানো হয়েছে। ২০২১ সালের ফেব্রুয়ারিতে সামরিক অভ্যুত্থানের মাধ্যমে সু কির নেতৃত্বাধীন নির্বাচিত বেসামরিক সরকারকে উৎখাত করে মিয়ানমারের সেনাবাহিনী। এরপর থেকেই তিনি আটক রয়েছেন। তাঁর সঠিক অবস্থান ও স্বাস্থ্য পরিস্থিতি সম্পর্কে দীর্ঘদিন ধরে নির্ভরযোগ্য তথ্য পাওয়া যাচ্ছিল না। কোনো বিদেশি রাষ্ট্রপ্রধান বা কূটনৈতিক প্রতিনিধি প্রকাশ্যে তাঁর সঙ্গে সাক্ষাৎ করতে পারেননি। যুক্তরাজ্যভিত্তিক সংবাদমাধ্যম ‘দ্য ইনডিপেনডেন্ট’ জানিয়েছে, সোমবার মিয়ানমার সরকারের প্রকাশিত ছবিতে সু চিকে সুস্থ ও স্বাভাবিক অবস্থায় দেখা গেছে। এর আগে গত ৩০ এপ্রিল রাষ্ট্রীয় গণমাধ্যমে প্রকাশিত একটি ছবিতে তাঁকে কাঠের বেঞ্চে বসে দুই ইউনিফর্ম পরিহিত কর্মকর্তার সঙ্গে কথা বলতে দেখা যায়। তবে ছবিটির সত্যতা নিয়ে প্রশ্ন ওঠে। এরপর সু চির ছেলে কিম অ্যারিস তাঁর মায়ের জীবিত থাকার স্বাধীনভাবে যাচাইযোগ্য প্রমাণ প্রকাশের দাবি জানান। কিম অ্যারিস দীর্ঘদিন ধরে তাঁর মায়ের মুক্তির জন্য আন্তর্জাতিক চাপ বাড়ানোর আহ্বান জানিয়ে আসছেন। #InternationalNews #news #somoytv

Powered by 101 🇮🇳🌿 India continues Her journey beyond a century in designating Ramsar Sites. Delighted to announce Glaw Lake as Arunachal Pradesh’s first Ramsar Site—a significant milestone for biodiversity, water and climate security, and sustainable livelihoods. Nestled within the Kamlang Tiger Reserve and Wildlife Sanctuary, this pristine freshwater lake in the Eastern Himalayas is a biodiversity hotspot. Fed by perennial mountain streams, it is surrounded by lush vegetation, with more than 150 tree species and 49 orchid species recorded within the site and its catchment. Under the leadership of PM Shri @narendramodi ji, India has emerged as a global leader in wetland conservation. From 26 Ramsar Sites in 2014 to 101 today, this remarkable journey reflects our unwavering commitment to environmental protection, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable development. Every new Ramsar Site strengthens our resolve to protect nature while securing the future of communities that depend on these invaluable ecosystems.

Here’s an HVT-style post that keeps the key caveats while remaining engaging and accurate. 🚨 OSINT ASSESSMENT: Pakistan’s SH-15 deployment claims deserve caution. Several Indian media outlets, citing unnamed intelligence sources, reported that Pakistan has deployed 250 SH-15 wheeled 155mm self-propelled howitzers near the border. Here’s what the evidence suggests: • Pakistan already operates the SH-15. The system is real, but reports of “250 units” closely match cumulative procurement and induction figures reported over recent years—not necessarily a brand-new frontline deployment. • No official confirmation has come from Pakistan’s ISPR or Ministry of Defence, and there is no publicly available satellite imagery independently verifying a sudden mass deployment. • The SH-15 is a capable 155mm/52-calibre wheeled artillery system. Typical combat ranges are around 30–40 km, while longer ranges require specialized extended-range ammunition that is not generally considered standard issue. • Claims linking the move directly to Operation Sindoor remain analytical interpretations rather than independently verified facts. Bottom line: Pakistan’s artillery modernization is real. A sudden deployment of 250 newly inducted SH-15s to the border is not yet confirmed by open-source evidence. Treat the reports as plausible but unverified until corroborated by official statements or independent imagery. #OSINT #Pakistan #Artillery #SH15 #Defence

اسلام آباد: 3 اگست 2026. وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت سرکاری اداروں کی نجکاری کے عمل میں پیش رفت کا جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا۔ اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ نجکاری پروگرام کے تحت طے شدہ تمام اہداف اور ٹائم لائنز پر عملدرآمد یقینی بنایا جائے. نجکاری کے مختلف مراحل کی بروقت تکمیل کے لیے متعلقہ وزارتیں اور ادارے باہمی رابطے سے کام کریں. زرعی ترقیاتی بینک کی نجکاری کا طریقہ کار اس انداز میں وضع کیا جائے کہ بینک کا بنیادی مقصد اور زرعی شعبے میں اس کا کردار برقرار رہے. یقینی بنایا جائے کہ نجکاری کے بعد بھی چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کے کسانوں کو زرعی قرضوں اور مالی وسائل کی فراہمی پر زرعی ترقیاتی بینک کی توجہ برقرار رہے۔ وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ کسانوں، بالخصوص چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کے کاشتکاروں کی فی ایکڑ پیداوار میں اضافے کیلئے مالی وسائل تک رسائی کو یقینی بنانا ضروری ہے۔ زرعی ترقی پاکستان کی معاشی ترقی اور غذائی تحفظ کے لیے بنیادی اہمیت رکھتی ہے. اجلاس میں وزارتِ نجکاری کی جانب سے وزیراعظم کو نجکاری پروگرام، مختلف سرکاری اداروں کی نجکاری کے لیے اب تک ہونے والی پیش رفت اور آئندہ کے اہداف پر تفصیلی بریفنگ دی گئی۔ اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ حکومت کے نجکاری پروگرام کے تحت مجموعی طور پر 27 سرکاری ادارے تین مختلف مراحل میں نجکاری کے ایجنڈے میں شامل ہیں۔ اجلاس کو آگاہ کیا گیا کہ پاکستان انٹرنیشنل ایئرلائنز (PIA) اور فرسٹ ویمن بینک کی نجکاری کے حوالے سے فنانشل کلوزنگ کا مرحلہ مکمل ہو چکا ہے۔ وزیراعظم کو بتایا گیا کہ پی آئی اے کی پہلی فنانشل کلوزنگ اور انتظامی کنٹرول کی منتقلی 29 جون 2026 کو مکمل ہوئی۔ وزیراعظم کو اسلام آباد الیکٹرک سپلائی کمپنی (IESCO)، فیصل آباد الیکٹرک سپلائی کمپنی (FESCO) اور گوجرانوالہ الیکٹرک پاور کمپنی (GEPCO) کی نجکاری کے عمل پر بھی بریفنگ دی گئی۔ اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ تینوں کمپنیوں کے لیے اظہارِ دلچسپی (EOI) مشتہر کیا جا چکا ہے جبکہ سرمایہ کاروں کی جانب سے دستاویزات جمع کرانے کی آخری تاریخ بالترتیب FESCO کے لیے 7 اگست، GEPCO کے لیے 21 اگست اور IESCO کے لیے 7 ستمبر 2026 مقرر کی گئی ہے۔ اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ ان تقسیم کار کمپنیوں کیلئے بین الاقوامی کمپنیوں نے دلچسپی کا اظہار کیا ہے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ اس حوالے سے سرمایہ کاروں کے ساتھ روڈ شوز کا عمل بھی جاری ہے۔ وزیراعظم کو زرعی ترقیاتی بینک لمیٹڈ (ZTBL) کی نجکاری کے حوالے سے ہونے والی پیش رفت سے بھی آگاہ کیا گیا۔ اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ زرعی ترقیاتی بینک کی ٹرانزیکشن اسٹرکچرنگ میں بینک کے زرعی قرضوں سے متعلق بنیادی مینڈیٹ کے تحفظ کو خصوصی طور پر مدنظر رکھا جا رہا ہے۔ اجلاس کو اسلام آباد انٹر نیشنل ایئر پورٹ، جناح انٹرنیشنل ایئرپورٹ کراچی اور علامہ اقبال انٹرنیشنل ایئرپورٹ لاہور کی نجکاری پر پیش رفت کے حوالے سے بھی آگاہ کیا گیا. وزیراعظم نے نجکاری کے تمام جاری معاملات کی پیش رفت کی مسلسل نگرانی اور طے شدہ اہداف کی بروقت تکمیل یقینی بنانے کی ہدایت کی۔ اجلاس میں نائب وزیرِ اعظم و وزیرِ خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء خواجہ محمد آصف، جام کمال خان، احد خان چیمہ، سردار اویس خان لغاری، وزیرِ مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، مشیرِ وزیرِ اعظم محمد علی، معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. Artificial intelligence is being sold as the biggest economic shock in a generation, a productivity revolution that will decide which countries grow rich and which fall behind. The machinery of it has already become a contest of power: chips have become chokepoints, compute is rationed by export controls, and the routine coding and back-office work that lifted millions across the developing world is squarely in the crosshairs. In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by two guides to the two halves of the story. Pranay Kotasthane (@pranaykotas) maps the geopolitics of AI, including the chips, the compute, and the contest for power. Economist Ashish Kulkarni brings in the economics and answers whether the productivity boom is real or overhyped, and who actually captures the gains. Together, they work through the question that matters most for India: does AI offer the developing world a shortcut up the ladder, or kick it away? Also, whether export controls actually work, and whether India should build its own "sovereign AI" or simply buy it in. CNN also reports that recent assessments from the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) and Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) conclude the current air campaign alone is unlikely to change Iran's negotiating position, while Joint Chiefs Chairman Gen. Dan Caine has publicly acknowledged that "air power has its limits." The reporting aligns with recent accounts from The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, Axios, and Reuters, which have described senior military leaders grappling with finite military options, dwindling air defense interceptor stockpiles, and the strategic limits of an air campaign absent a broader escalation.

At 9:23 this morning, the White House abruptly dismissed the press traveling with the president of the United States while he was away for the weekend at his private golf club in Bedminster, New Jersey. With the cameras now gone, just three hours later at 12:32 p.m., Donald Trump would share the first of 42 posts on Truth Social in a span of less than 3 hours and 15 minutes. The president’s public meltdown began when he posted his disappointment with one of his appointees, “I don’t know what she was thinking?” before he jumped straight into more delusional and dangerous images. Among the flood of posts, he shared an AI-generated image of himself kissing Jesus on a golden crucifix. He shared a “TRUMP 2028” campaign poster, a fake image of himself walking beside a handcuffed alien on a military base, and a renewed threat to invade Greenland. He didn’t stop there. He posted a painting of himself as the commanding general, leading Revolutionary War soldiers into battle with his mouth open in a battle cry, while flames consumed the battlefield behind him, and a battered American flag flew overhead. This is how he sees himself. Not as a president spending the weekend at his golf course, but as a warrior king leading his nation into battle, one he would have never had the courage to actually fight in. That fantasy is not harmless, because right now he is leading us deeper into a real war where real people have died. He also shared a fake image of his face merged with President George Washington’s, split straight down the middle, under the words “250 Years / In God We Trust.” It was a deliberate attempt to place himself alongside the founder of the American republic. Because he sees himself as his equal and inseparable from the nation itself. He’s saying he is Washington and he is the republic. He posted a map of South America with Venezuela filled in as an American flag and labeled “51st State.” He shared an actual photograph of himself stepping out of a golf cart, hunched forward, a white USA hat in his hand, looking every single day of his eighty years, but with the caption “President Trump ages in reverse!” Then there was the created image of himself as Elvis Presley in his iconic white rhinestone jumpsuit, with a deep V-neck and with his chest exposed, and a bald eagle embroidered across his heart. In it, Trump, masquerading as Elvis, stands in front of a microphone as though he is about to perform for a waiting crowd. And I couldn’t help but think about the irony of Trump choosing Elvis in this moment, knowing that he spent his final years overmedicated and isolated, surrounded by enablers who told him what he wanted to hear while his body and mind deteriorated. And how Elvis died alone in a bathroom at Graceland while the people closest to him pretended everything was fine. If Trump was trying to choose a metaphor for where he is right now, he could not have picked a more accurate one. He just kept going. He posted an image of himself as a young man in a military school uniform, seated across a table from present-day Trump, with the caption “Same Guy. Even more energy now!” Present-day Trump is staring adorably at younger Trump. But what the image actually shows is the distance between who he was and who he has become. The young man in the uniform is upright, sharp, but not too far away from bone spurs and draft deferments. The man sitting across from him is eighty years old, and struggling. The fact that he felt compelled to post this, to insist publicly that nothing has changed, tells us everything about what he is afraid of. People who are fine do not need to prove they are fine. People who are declining do.

سفر میں مسلسل معاونت پر شکریہ ادا کیا۔ وزیراعظم نے کہا کہ حکومت معیشت کو مستحکم اور پائیدار ترقی کی راہ پر گامزن کرنے کے لیے اصلاحات کے ایجنڈے پر بھرپور عملدرآمد جاری رکھے ہوئے ہے۔ پاکستان کا آئینی وفاقی ڈھانچہ، صوبائی خودمختاری اور وفاق اور صوبوں کے درمیان باہمی تعاون و مشاورت ملک کی ترقی اور استحکام کے لیے بنیادی اہمیت رکھتے ہیں. ورلڈ بینک کی کنٹری ڈائریکٹر نے "پاکستان میں مالیاتی وفاقیت کو مضبوط بنانے" (Strengthening Fiscal Federalism in Pakistan) رپورٹ پیش کی اور رپورٹ کے مندرجات پر بریفننگ دی۔ ورلڈ بینک کے وفد نے اپنی رپورٹ کے اہم نکات پیش کرتے ہوئے پاکستان میں اٹھارہویں آئینی ترمیم اور ساتویں قومی مالیاتی کمیشن (این ایف سی) ایوارڈ کے بعد مالیاتی وفاقیت کے ارتقاء، محصولات، اخراجات، وفاقی و صوبائی مالیاتی تعلقات، ادارہ جاتی ہم آہنگی اور عوامی وسائل کے استعمال سے متعلق اپنے تجزیے اور مشاہدات سے آگاہ کیا۔ وفد نے اپنی رپورٹ میں مختلف پالیسی سفارشات بھی پیش کیں جن کا مقصد، مالیاتی نظم و ضبط، وسائل کے مؤثر استعمال، خدمات کی فراہمی میں بہتری اور وفاقی و صوبائی اداروں کے درمیان مؤثر تعاون کو فروغ دینا ہے۔ وزیراعظم نے کہا کہ عالمی بینک کی جانب سے پیش کیا گیا تجزیہ اور بین الاقوامی تجربات کی روشنی میں تقابلی جائزہ لائق تحسین ہے، ایسے مطالعات پالیسی سازی کے عمل میں مفید رہنمائی فراہم کرنے میں کلیدی اہمیت کے حامل ہیں۔ وزیراعظم نے رپورٹ کا تفصیلی جائزہ لینے کے لیے اعلیٰ سطحی کمیٹی قائم کرنے کی ہدایت دی۔ یہ کمیٹی عالم بینک کی رپورٹ میں پیش کی گئی سفارشات کا متعلقہ فریقین بشمول صوبوں سے مشاورت اور پاکستان کے آئینی و وفاقی ڈھانچے کو مدنظر رکھتے ہوئے جائزہ لے گی، تاکہ عوامی مفاد میں قابلِ عمل تجاویز پر غور کیا جا سکے۔ ملاقات میں نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء احد خان چیمہ اور احسن اقبال، مشیر وزیر اعظم ڈاکٹر سید توقیر شاہ، وزیر مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی اور اعلیٰ سرکاری حکام بھی موجود تھے۔. ICRIER is pleased to welcome @DrShashwatAlok as a Visiting Professor. Prof. Alok is an Associate Professor of Finance at @ISBedu and Research Director, @DIRI_ISB. His research examines how digital infrastructure, data, fintech, policy, and regulation shape financial markets, expand financial inclusion, and affect firms and households in emerging economies. His recent work studies how fintech, alternative data, and public digital infrastructure can expand credit access, improve risk assessment, and reshape competition between banks and fintech lenders, alongside ongoing research on open banking, Buy Now Pay Later, and financial innovation. His research has been published in leading journals, including the Review of Financial Studies, Management Science, the Journal of Law and Economics, and the Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis. His research has informed policy discussions in India, including through the Indian Economic Survey, the Reserve Bank of India’s Household Finance Committee Report, and his participation in pre-Budget consultations with the Prime Minister of India. He holds a PhD in Finance from Washington University in St. Louis and a BE in Computer Science from Manipal University. We look forward to the depth his expertise in fintech, digital infrastructure, and financial inclusion will bring to ICRIER's research.

Tamil Nadu has set up a committee under Montek Singh Ahluwalia to find more revenue. This piece by N Muthuraman argues that the committee's job is not to find new taxes. The numbers first. - The state owes over Rs 10 lakh crore directly and more than Rs 13 lakh crore in total liabilities. That is 28.3 per cent of its economy, against Karnataka's 23.4, Maharashtra's 19.7 and Gujarat's 17.6. - Its own tax collection has fallen to 5.45 per cent of GSDP, the lowest in two decades. The usual answer is a new cess or a higher rate. But Muthuraman's argument is that Tamil Nadu's problem is not that it taxes too little. It is that it charges too little for what it already owns and does — monetisation. What does that mean in practice? - Water tariffs across most of the state bear no relation to what supply costs, and multi-storey buildings and commercial establishments pay the same rates as low-income households. - Thousands of government properties sit on leases that expired years ago, still at their old rents. - Property-tax collections rise 10 to 35 per cent in states that map holdings using GIS. - Mature state highways could be monetised the way NHAI does it. - He also argues premium liquor licences are allotted administratively instead of auctioned, with production concentrated in politician-owned capacity. N Muthuraman, in his piece, has set out more than fifty ideas across taxation, pricing, asset monetisation, public enterprises and compliance. 1. Depending on where your politics comes from you might see Jantar Mantar as a revolution, or as a passing sandstorm. My arguments won’t change any minds. I shall try, however, to say what’s happened & what hasn’t. #NationalInterest. 2. First of all, it was Gen Z defiance in the face of much physical risk, evident in their resolve to return to Jantar Mantar even after the beatings on 20 July. Second, a nearly reckless loss of fear of what this might mean for their careers. This was the angriest student protest in Delhi after the anti-Mandal agitation. 3. These young people broke the self-imposed silence among the elites not to speak a word critical of the Modi govt. And it isn’t going to stop. They also showed there’s a large demographic unimpressed with slogans of Viksit Bharat or Amrit Kaal. By 2047, the oldest Gen Z-er today will be 50. And the youngest 35. Their lives would’ve passed them by. Who has patience to wait that long? 4. Which brings us to what this protest wasn’t. First, no revolution has broken out & you can give Faiz Ahmad Faiz’s invocation a break. Northern India is choked with millions of kanwariyas. Many will have loud ‘DJs’, eat ‘bhandaras’ set up by the faithful, have UP govt helicopters spray flowers over them. Most of them are also Gen Z. The short point is there’s also a lot of loyal young with the BJP. 5. Competitive politics up to 2029 now will be about filling the breach the Gen Z has caused, or widening it. The BJP acknowledges its problem. That’s why the PM is now speaking on Instagram. But can he rejuvenate his govt? In the Cabinet, the same cast has played musical chairs. Of the ministries that directly affect the young, Education has its 5th minister, Skill Development has seen 4. 6. What the Gen Z protest has done is to open the door for Modi’s opposition. They’ve exposed more than a chink in the armour. It’s a widening gap between govt’s perception of its popularity among its most loyal base & the growing fatigue among a significant enough number of them. The Congress has got 3 years to work on this opening. Just what the BJP has got to reboot & rebuild. 7. Day 2 | al-Hidayah 2026 | Canada His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Lectures on the Love of Allah and the Longing for the Divine Vision Hamilton, Ontario (Canada): The second day of al-Hidayah Canada 2026, the first-ever three-day residential, spiritual and educational camp of its kind in North America at McMaster University, featured the second part of the three-day keynote lecture series by His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Prof. Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri. The session addressed the spiritual treatment of heedlessness ghafla (غفلة) through the love of Allah the Almighty and the longing for the vision of His Divine Countenance. Continuing the lecture series "From Humanity to Depravity: A Moral and Spiritual Descent," Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that while the opening session had analysed the process of moral decline, beginning with ghaflah, the second session would present one remedy drawn from the complete prescription for its removal izālat al-ghafla (إزالة الغفلة). This is only achievable through kindling the love of Allah in one’s hearts and nurture the desire for the moment when the believers will behold His Delightful Countenance in the Hereafter. He noted that the third and concluding session would explore the psychological, neurological, Qur'anic and spiritual dimensions of ghaflah in detail, along with the complete methodology of its treatment. The Supplication of the Beloved Prophet (ﷺ) Shaykh-ul-Islam anchored the session in the supplication of the Holy Prophet (ﷺ), reported by Imam Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal in his Musnad, Imam al-Nasāʾī in his Sunan, and Ibn Ḥibbān in his Ṣaḥīḥ: "O Allah, I ask You for the delight of gazing upon Your Noble Countenance and for the longing to meet You." (As’aluka ladhdhata al-naẓari ilā wajhika wa al-shawqa ilā liqā’iqa (أسألك لذة النظر إلى وجهك والشوق إلى لقائك). He described this as among the most beloved supplications to the Holy Prophet (ﷺ) and invited the audience to make it the direction and longing of their own lives. The Promised Vision of the Divine Countenance Drawing upon the agreed-upon hadith of Sayyidunā Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh (R.A), Shaykh-ul-Islam explained the Prophetic promise: "Indeed, you will see your Lord just as you see this full moon, without difficulty in seeing Him." He elaborated that the wording ʿiyānan (عيانًا) in the narration of Imam al-Bukhārī conveys an actual and direct vision, free from doubt, speculation and mere imagination, a capacity Allah will grant to the eyes of the believers on the Day of Judgment. He then presented the narration of Sayyidunā Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh (RA), reported in Sunan Ibn Mājah: while the people of Paradise are immersed in their bliss, a light will shine upon them; they will raise their heads and behold their Lord, who will greet them with the words "Peace be upon you, O people of Paradise." The Holy Prophet (ﷺ) explained that this is the meaning of the Qur'anic verse "Peace!—a word from a Most Merciful Lord." (Qur'an 36:58) So long as they gaze upon Him, they will pay no attention to any other delight of Paradise; and when the veil returns, His light and blessing will remain upon them and their dwellings. Citing the narration of Sayyidunā ʿAlī (AS), recorded by Imām al-Mundhirī in al-Targhīb wa al-Tarhīb and gathered by ʿAllāmah Ibn al-Qayyim in Rawḍat al-Muḥibbīn, he described how Almighty Allah will send the Trustworthy Spirit to the people of Paradise with the announcement: "O people of Paradise, your Lord sends you His greeting of peace and commands you to visit Him in the open court of Paradise." The people of Paradise will come forth radiant with glad tidings, and there the supreme honour will be bestowed upon them: the vision of His Most Generous Countenance. In further narrations on the subject recorded by Imam al-Mundhirī and gathered by ʿAllāmah Ibn al-Qayyim, Shaykh-ul-Islam related that upon beholding the Countenance of the Lord of all the worlds, the people of Paradise will be overwhelmed by the majesty of that encounter and exclaim, "Subḥānaka! Mā ʿabadnāka ḥaqqa ʿibādatik." ("Glory be to You! We have not worshipped You as You deserve to be worshipped."). Allah the Almighty will reply, "By My grace, I have granted you the vision of My Countenance and admitted you into My Abode." Practical Preparation for the Meeting with Allah Shaykh-ul-Islam stressed that longing for the Divine Vision demands more than wishes and emotions; it requires practical obedience. He outlined a programme of preparation: guarding the obligatory prayers, declaring "I can die, but I cannot miss a ṣalāh," for prayer is the believer's rehearsal for standing before Allah; sincere and daily repentance, for in the eyes of the lovers no sin is minor; lowering the gaze and purifying the eyes; abandoning unlawful deeds, relationships and income; cleansing the heart of jealousy, arrogance and malice; constant remembrance of Allah; and serving the entirety of Allah's creation, in the light of the hadith, "All creation is the family of Allah, and the most beloved to Him is the one most beneficial to His family." He explained that the true believer lives between hope and fear al-khawf wa al-rajāʾ (الخوف والرجاء): hope inspires love, longing and passion for meeting with Allah, while fear protects the believer from heedlessness, arrogance and persistence in disobedience. The Door of Prostration In the concluding portion of the lecture, Shaykh-ul-Islam expounded the secret of sujūd (السجود): the body descends into its lowest physical position while the soul rises to its highest station. Ablution purifies the body, he explained, while prostration purifies the heart, removing pride, heedlessness and distance from Allah. He urged the youth to teach their foreheads to recognise the prayer mat, to fill their youth with prostration before age and weakness overtake the body, and to rise in the darkness of the night, for this world is the abode of deeds and the Hereafter the abode of reward: Paradise is the harvest, and this life the field in which it must be planted. Recalling the weeping of Yazid al-Raqqashi at the approach of death, who said, "I weep for the night prayers I shall no longer be able to offer," he delivered his parting message to the attendees: "Who will pray for you when the time is gone? Do not be deceived by your youth. Change your life, change your priorities, and live to know Allah, to love Allah, and to please Allah. This is the supreme success." Shaykh-ul-Islam repeatedly invited the attendees to commit to a life of preparation for the meeting with their Lord, and the session concluded amid expressions of devotion from the participants. Accompanying His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam were Prof Dr Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri (Chairman Supreme Council, MQI), Shaykh Hammad Mustafa al-Madani al-Qadri, Shaykh Ahmad Mustafa al-Arabi al-Qadri, Dr Faisal Iqbal Khan, Syed Shahzad Ali Faizi, Syed Saad Ali Faizi, Syed Soban Ali Faizi, Dr Ghazala Qadri (President of Minhaj-ul-Quran Women League International), and Baji Khadija Qurat-ul-Ain Qadri, each exemplifying leadership in the pursuit of authentic, scholarly Islam. The event also saw the presence of distinguished guests Peter Fonseca, MP Ontario, Canada; Shaykh Yasser Ahmed Albaz; Shaykh Waleed Almakee, founder of Noon Academy; Shaykh Nisar Sulaimani; Shaykh Abdulaziz from Dar Foundation, along with other participants from North America. #AlHidayah2026 #MinhajulQuran #ShaykhulIslam #DrTahirulQadri #SpiritualJourney #LoveOfAllah #Hamilton #Canada #McMasterUniversity

The economy Pakistan forgot to measure In her latest article in @dawn_com, Nabila Kunwal, Research Economist at PIDE, highlights the vast economy Pakistan has failed to measure: unpaid work. From supporting family farms and businesses to childcare, cooking and household management, millions of women contribute daily without wages or formal recognition. When unpaid market and domestic work are included, nearly 78% of Pakistani women are engaged in productive activity. Pakistan cannot design effective economic policies while ignoring work that may represent almost one-third of its economy. It is time to recognise, measure and value the labour that keeps families and businesses running. Michigan US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed said US taxpayer dollars should be focused on the needs of Americans rather than unconditional military aid to foreign governments in an interview with MS Now. Responding to a question about whether his criticism of excessive US funding for Israel could echo antisemitic tropes, El-Sayed drew a fine distinction between criticising government policy and prejudice against a people or faith. He said he stands with the Jewish community against antisemitism and that antisemitism and Islamophobia must both be confronted. El-Sayed outlined his position that the United States should not provide unconditional military aid to any government while Americans continue to face challenges with healthcare, education, and other essential needs at home. He said this principle applies across countries, pointing to aid for Egypt as another example, and said US foreign policy decisions should be evaluated based on the priorities of American taxpayers and communities. The Commonwealth Games 2026 will be remembered as a landmark chapter in India's sporting journey, defined by historic firsts, record-breaking performances, and the rise of a new generation of champions. Under the visionary leadership of PM Shri @narendramodi, India's sustained investment in sports infrastructure, athlete welfare, and grassroots talent continues to translate into historic success on the global stage. India finished atop the boxing medal table, delivering its finest-ever Commonwealth Games performance. No country has ever won more gold medals in boxing at a single edition of the Commonwealth Games, a remarkable achievement that underscores India's growing dominance in the ring. Athletics reached unprecedented heights with India's best-ever performance at a Commonwealth Games held outside home soil. The Games witnessed several historic firsts, including India's first-ever medals in both the men's 5000m and 10000m at a single Commonwealth Games, the first decathlon medal, historic Judo golds, and many other pathbreaking achievements. Para-athletics also reached a historic milestone, with India securing its first-ever Commonwealth Games gold in the men's Shot Put F57 event and registering the nation's first double podium finish in the category, highlighting the growing strength and depth of Indian para-sport. These remarkable performances reflect the dedication of our athletes, coaches, and support staff, and the strength of a sporting ecosystem that continues to nurture excellence. Heartiest congratulations to every member of Team India. The nation is immensely proud of you.

A fuel price increase does not stop at the petrol station. It travels through irrigation, farming, transport, storage and wholesale markets before reaching household kitchens—raising the cost of flour, vegetables, milk, poultry and other essentials. Food inflation is no longer only an agricultural problem; it is also an energy problem. Pakistan needs solar-powered irrigation, improved cold-chain and storage facilities, greater use of rail transport and better fuel-price planning. Pakistan’s food security should not depend on the price of the next barrel of crude oil. Dramatic cliffs and centuries of history come together at Longmen Tianguan, or Dragon Gate Heavenly Pass, one of the highlights of the Yesanpo Scenic Area in Baoding, Hebei province. Renowned for its distinctive canyon landscape, it was once an important pass linking the capital with the northern frontier. The canyon's towering cliffs preserve dozens of inscriptions dating back to the Ming and Qing (1368-1911) dynasties, with the monumental characters "Wanren Tianguan" (Heavenly Pass of Towering Cliffs) standing out as the most iconic. With the rise of large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Hasidic communities are grappling with the intersection between AI and the need to preserve religious customs. Groups that are amenable to new technology, such as rabbis affiliated with the Chabad-Lubavitch movement, are designing their own AI applications. Meanwhile, firms that serve more insular movements, including Satmar, are using AI to filter the internet and restrict access to LLMs to prevent responses on sensitive topics. Rav Dicta is among the first AI applications made in collaboration with Hasidic leaders. The program — one of several similar initiatives affiliated with the Chabad movement — is an early example of how Orthodox groups are sculpting AI for their own purposes, and how AI can influence religious practice in turn. One vessel to watch is the Bahamas-flagged, Qatar-owned Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) carrier Al Areesh. Automatic Information System (AIS) data from MarineTraffic.com indicates the vessel has now reached the U.S. enforced naval blockade line at the entrance to the Gulf of Oman twice. After transiting outbound through the Strait of Hormuz on July 29 using Iran's traffic separation scheme, Al Areesh reached the apparent blockade line before reversing course back into the Gulf of Oman. It has now returned to the blockade line, but rather than continuing seaward or turning back again, is loitering in a north-south pattern along the blockade line. The vessel's movements are noteworthy because as a Bahamas-flagged, Qatar owned LNG carrier outbound from the Persian Gulf, it does not appear to fall within the publicly stated scope of the U.S. blockade, which U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) has described as restricting commercial traffic supporting Iran. If U.S. forces are delaying or preventing the vessel from departing the Gulf, the rationale is currently unclear. Alternatively, the vessel may be awaiting routing instructions, clearance, or a commercial decision by its operator. AIS data alone cannot determine the reason for its current behavior.

Following the impact, the lower helicopter crashes to the ground, while the second, despite apparent damage to its water bucket/tank assembly, remains airborne and is able to continue flying. Both helicopters were operated by McDermott Aviation, an Australian aerial firefighting company with operations across Australia, the United States, and Europe. The cause of the collision remains under investigation. Video

Over the last few weeks, the situation for Ukraine on the frontline has rapidly deteriorated in an unprecedented manner not seen since early 2025. In the northeastern corner Kharkiv Oblast, Russia has achieved two localised breakthroughs, threatening to encircle more than 360 km² of Ukrainian-controlled territory. In the Dobropillya direction, one of the most formidable Ukrainian strongholds which has stood for over a year has been breached, with Russian forces now flooding Ukrainian positions in the urban agglomeration between Pokrovsk and Dobropillya. In the Kramatorsk/Slovyansk direction, Ukraine has been unable to slow down Russian advances, with Russia now coming within 4.7 km of both Slovyansk and Kramatorsk, and coming close to fully capturing the crucial tactical ridgeline east of these two final Donbas cities. In the Kostyantynivka direction, Russia has captured Chasiv Yar after 840 days of battles, and has almost completed the capture of Kostyantynivka. The salient west of Chasiv Yar is falling apart day by day as Ukraine withdraws. In the Druzhkivka direction, Russia achieved a localised breakthrough of up to 6 km, capturing 3 villages and entering 3 others, coming within 5.1 km of Druzhkivka, and threatening the Ukrainian salient west of Kostyantynivka with encirclement. In the Omelnyk direction, Russia has finally captured the Ukrainian stronghold town of Zaliznychne after over 7 months of battles, and are making new advances west of the Haichur River towards Vozdyvzhivka. In the Stepnohirsk direction, Russia has halted the Ukrainian counterattacks and have begun retaking previously lost ground, advancing northeast of Kamyanske and north from Mali Shcherbaky. In the Kupyansk direction, the crucial Ukrainian bridgehead east of the Oskil River continues to shrink day by day, with Russian forces expanding their zone of control in the area of Novosynove, Kivsharivka, Pishchane, Petropavlivka, and Kupyansk itself. Ukraine is losing incredibly important defensive positions necessary for holding the frontline in the future, especially the areas south of Dobropillya which should not be falling this quickly. However, they are seemingly intent on concentrating their assault forces in counterattacks north of Lyman, west of Komar, and south of Novopavlivka, which have questionable (at best) strategic reasoning for the heavy cost being endured. The new Ukrainian Commander-in-Chief Mykhailo Drapatyi has inherited a situation that is getting worse by the day, and will have to make some serious and difficult decisions in order to try stabilise it towards the end of Summer.

Jeremy Clarkson opened a pub in August 2024 with one rule: every single ingredient British. Here is what that rule immediately deleted from a perfectly ordinary pub. - No coffee. - No Coca-Cola. - No gin and tonic. Quinine will not grow here. - No lemons. No limes. - No ketchup, for two years. - No avocado. No pineapple. His own line was that instead of a slice of lemon you would be offered a slice of turnip. That list is not a gimmick. It is an audit of how much of a normal British menu now arrives by ship, and the answer turns out to be most of the small things nobody thinks about. Then the figure underneath it all. A sausage made from his own pigs costs 74p. The same sausage made from imported pig meat costs 18p. He is absorbing that gap on every plate that leaves the kitchen, which is precisely the gap every British pig farmer is asked to compete across, without a television programme paying the difference. And the ketchup has the best ending in the whole story. So many people asked for it that a sign went up telling them to stop. Then a producer in Chatham built one out of Isle of Wight passata, Hampshire cider vinegar and Essex salt, and it went on the menu. The demand was always sat there. Nobody had bothered building the supply.

Spain is facing its most serious migration crisis in years after a mass surge into the North African enclave of Ceuta left at least 72 people dead and reignited debate over European border security. According to Spanish authorities, more than 50,000 people attempted to enter Ceuta from Morocco by land and sea, overwhelming local resources. While the vast majority have since returned to Morocco, Spanish officials continue to recover bodies, reinforce the border, and investigate the role of human smuggling networks and online misinformation in fueling the surge. The crisis has prompted a broader European response. Twenty-two EU member states have called for stronger external border protections, Spain has installed a 500-meter floating sea barrier off Ceuta, and Italy temporarily reinstated border controls with Spain, citing security concerns. Until this incident, Spain had actually experienced a decline in irregular migration during 2026. Through the end of June, 12,138 migrants had entered Spain irregularly; 32% fewer than during the same period in 2025. Arrivals to the Canary Islands were down sharply, while land crossings into Ceuta and Melilla had already increased by more than 150% year-over-year, foreshadowing mounting pressure along Spain's North African land border. 250,000 books. That is how many my Ukrainian publisher, Knygolove knigolove.ua/ lost on 19 July after three Russian Iskander missiles struck the warehouse outside Kyiv. Among them were my books, too. This is war, and war inevitably brings human and material losses. But when books burn, it is not just paper that burns. Culture, memory, and identity burn with them. So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

The magnificent world of wild animals ❤️❤️❤️ A moose was slamming into cars, trying to protect what looked like his calf, until people realized he wasn’t guarding his calf at all. In Washington State, traffic came to a stop after drivers saw a moose standing in the road, ramming into the doors of any car that tried to move too close. At first, nobody understood why he was acting so aggressive. Moose can be dangerous, but this one wasn’t just wandering or blocking traffic. He was guarding something. From a distance, some thought it was a moose calf lying in the road. But when people recording zoomed in, they realized it wasn’t a moose calf at all. It was a bear cub. The cub looked like it was asleep or dead in the middle of the road, while the moose stood over it like every passing car was a threat. When wildlife officials arrived, they tried to move the moose back toward the woods, but he refused to leave the cub. Every time they got close, the moose stepped forward like he was ready to fight anything that came near. That’s when officials realized the bear cub wasn’t sleeping. It had been hit by a car and left there. The scene changed instantly. What first looked like a strange wild encounter became something much heavier, because the moose wasn’t confused or angry for no reason. He was standing guard over an injured bear cub, keeping traffic away from the same kind of danger that had already hurt it. Officials were finally able to help the cub and move the moose safely back toward the woods & the people that witnessed it all will never forget that magnificent moose 🫎

Un segundo logro de las colocaciones en moneda local fue que, en un contexto de condiciones financieras más estables, se pudo extender el plazo promedio de la deuda. Y esa extensión de plazos, resalta Quantum, se hizo “a tasas alineadas con la expectativa de inflación y depreciación, mediante una oferta variada de instrumentos”. El tercer aspecto que destaca el informe es que al acumular recursos en pesos para diversos “gastos eventuales, incluyendo la compra de dólares al Banco Central”, el Tesoro logró aumentar los recursos para atender pagos de la deuda y otras obligaciones en esa moneda. 🔗infob.ae/3RLOQCP

El itinerario veraniego incluyó una escala en Jamaica, donde los dos realizaron excursiones naturales y participaron en un encuentro privado con familiares de Bob Marley, según detallaron medios brasileños. Posteriormente, regresaron a Brasil, donde recorrieron el Cristo Redentor en Río y visitaron Sao Goncalo, barrio natal del delantero, en compañía de José Leonardo, hijo menor de Fonseca. LA CIUDAD DE NEUQUÉN APROBÓ UNA ORDENANZA QUE PROHÍBE FUMAR EN LAS PLAZAS Y EN LAS VEREDAS DE LOS COLEGIOS Durante años, la imagen de personas fumando en bares, oficinas públicas, restaurantes o salas de espera fue parte de la vida cotidiana. Sin embargo, la implementación progresiva de leyes antitabaco -desde hace unas dos décadas- modificó profundamente esos hábitos y consolidó una nueva conciencia social sobre los riesgos del humo para la salud. Ahora, la ciudad de Neuquén aprobó una ordenanza que extiende la protección a determinados espacios abiertos frecuentados por familias y menores de edad. La iniciativa fue aprobada por el Concejo Deliberante en junio y establece la creación de espacios libres de humo en plazas, parques temáticos, sectores recreativos de la costa ribereña y veredas de establecimientos educativos. Se trata de una encuesta de la consultora Zentrix según la cual al evaluar la situación personal y la marcha de la economía dos de cada tres argentinos dijeron que sus ingresos se agotan el día 20 del mes. El punto de partida de esa evaluación, según surge del informe de la encuesta, “es un salario que perdió la carrera contra los precios y no la recupera: el 87,4% de los encuestados afirma que su ingreso no le gana a la inflación, un techo que ya no distingue posiciones políticas: el 73% de los votantes oficialistas admite esa pérdida, cifra que entre los opositores trepa al 97,1 por ciento”. Zentrix subraya que la la diferencia entre ambos electorados no está en si el deterioro existe sino en cómo se lo nombra: costo de transición para unos, fracaso económico para otros. “Cuando una experiencia material es tan transversal que alcanza incluso a quienes respaldan al Gobierno deja de ser un problema de gestión para convertirse en una condición de época”, afirma. 🔗infob.ae/4xgz7uP

LA DECISIÓN DEL ASTON VILLA SOBRE EL FUTURO DE DIBU MARTÍNEZ FRENTE AL INTERÉS DE UN GIGANTE DE EUROPA La directiva del Aston Villa recibió en las últimas horas una confirmación clave sobre el futuro de Emiliano Dibu Martínez. Según informó el periodista especializado en fichajes Fabrizio Romano, el club inglés fue notificado por la Juventus acerca de su decisión de no avanzar en las negociaciones por el arquero argentino. La institución italiana consideró que los costos del traspaso resultan excesivos, una postura que fue comunicada formalmente a la dirigencia de Birmingham tras varios días de deliberación interna. La información de La Gazzetta dello Sport aportó detalles sobre las razones detrás de este giro. En el complejo deportivo de Continassa, la Juventus explora alternativas para la portería a poco más de un mes del inicio de la Serie A, mientras cuatro arqueros trabajan bajo la supervisión de Luciano Spalletti y su cuerpo técnico. Ninguno de ellos figura como titular indiscutible para el estreno liguero, un panorama que llevó a la directiva a identificar a Martínez como su “Plan A” para reforzar el arco. Sin embargo, la operación no prosperó por diferencias económicas. La prensa italiana explicó que la Vecchia Signora realizó varios intentos para acercar una propuesta a los directivos del Aston Villa, aunque el club inglés se mantuvo firme en su exigencia de 12 millones de euros por el pase del arquero marplatense. La Juventus evaluó que ese precio está fuera de su alcance y, como consecuencia, optó por descartar la operación. “Juve considera que los costos del traspaso son demasiado altos”, puntualizó Fabrizio Romano en su reporte. 🔗infob.ae/4wD1K5v

DESDE LLA LE PONEN PAÑOS FRÍOS A UNA POSIBLE ALIANZA CON EL PRO: “NI SIQUIERA SABEMOS SI VAMOS A COMPARTIR EL PROYECTO DE CIUDAD” La presidenta del bloque de La Libertad Avanza en la Legislatura de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, Pilar Ramírez, rechazó adelantar definiciones sobre posibles alianzas políticas en el distrito de cara a las elecciones de 2027 y subrayó que el oficialismo libertario se encuentra abocado a la gestión legislativa y al desarrollo de proyectos para la ciudad. “Lo que nosotros no vamos a hacer es hoy hablar de una alianza cuando todavía falta un montón, porque ni siquiera sabemos si vamos a compartir o no el proyecto de ciudad que nosotros tenemos”, sostuvo Ramírez en una entrevista en el programa Empezando el Día, conducido por Mariana Contartessi en Radio La Red. La diputada remarcó que “este es un año de gestión y falta muchísimo para el año que viene. Y el año que viene discutiremos cómo son las candidaturas”. Consultada sobre una posible candidatura de Patricia Bullrich en la Ciudad y la chance de acompañarla, Ramírez valoró la trayectoria de Bullrich y afirmó que “cualquier afiliado a la Libertad Avanza está en condiciones de ser candidato”, aunque reiteró que “falta muchísimo para esas definiciones”. 🔗infob.ae/4yTUILc

The U.S. State Department renewed its warning yesterday for Americans across the Middle East, urging heightened vigilance amid the increasingly volatile regional security environment. Americans currently in the region are advised to consider departing while commercial travel remains available or be prepared to leave if the situation deteriorates. The advisory warns of potential flight cancellations, periodic airspace closures, and other travel disruptions. Americans outside the region are urged to reconsider travel to or through the Middle East. The updated warning follows a series of increasingly specific security alerts issued in recent weeks, including notices for Jordan, Bahrain, and, for the first time, Egypt, reflecting the geographic expansion of Iranian attacks and concerns that Iran or Iran-backed groups could target U.S. diplomatic facilities, businesses, and other American interests both within and beyond the Middle East.

Ukraine's long-range drone campaign appears to have struck another Wildberries distribution center, this time in Novosyomyeikino, continuing a sustained effort to target Russia's largest e-commerce and logistics network. According to Russian officials, the strike ignited a fire at the facility. This video from Telegram purportedly shows a massive fire at the facility following the earlier Ukrainian drone strike. Wildberries is essentially Russia's equivalent of Amazon, operating the country's largest online marketplace with an extensive nationwide warehousing and distribution network. Ukraine argues the company supports Russia's war effort by selling dual-use goods and equipment used by the military, an allegation Moscow denies. The attack is the latest in a broader campaign that has targeted roughly a dozen Wildberries facilities since mid-July, disrupting an estimated 10% of the company's logistics capacity and forcing the retailer to reroute shipments, compensate victims, and absorb significant financial losses. The strikes reflect Ukraine's increasing focus on economic and logistics infrastructure well beyond the front lines, aiming to raise the cost of sustaining Russia's war effort while disrupting everyday commerce. The U.S. Air Force KC-135 "Stratotanker" that survived the fatal midair collision with another KC-135 over Iraq in March is now en route towards the United Kingdom, likely beginning its return to the United States. Based on the extensive structural damage sustained in the collision, it is likely the aircraft was repaired using a replacement tail section sourced from a retired KC-135 at the 309th Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group, aka the "Boneyard", at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Tucson, Arizona. While the U.S. Air Force has not publicly detailed the repair, such component replacements are a well established practice for returning heavily damaged aircraft to service.

Сьогодні Повітряні Сили – це значно більше ніж один із видів військ. Це складова нашого захисту, яка багато в чому реально визначає перебіг цієї війни. Українці не віддали і не віддають росіянам своє небо. І один з найбільш вагомих результатів нашого народу за час повномасштабної війни. Ми не дали знищити наші Повітряні Сили та змогли розвинути їх так, що Росія регулярно втрачає свої літаки. І зараз, коли єдиною ставкою, останньою ставкою, яка залишилась у Путіна, є його масовані удари проти України, Повітряні Сили – наша бойова авіація знищує російські крилаті ракети, старається знищити балістику, і, коли дивізіони наших «петріотів» не пусті, це вдається. Важливо, що завдяки нашій співпраці з Європою наші «айріси», «хоки», «насамси» працюють. Ми кожен день боремось за постачання ракет до них. І я вдячний, що партнери в світі нам із цим допомагають. Звісно, що балістика залишається проблемою, але ми забезпечили Україні захист від значної кількості крилатих ракет і збиваємо суттєво. Рівень збиття ударних дронів теж більше 90%, і це дуже вагомий результат України – усіх нас, усіх вас. Я дякую всім вам – усім присутнім тут, кожному й кожній з оборонців українського неба, які попри фактично нерівний бій та недостатність засобів для збиття роблять неймовірні речі – роблять більше ніж максимум. Ви показали світу майстерність і довели: українці спроможні долати будь-що і потрібні для цього лише зброя і засоби. Пишаємося вами. І шануємо всіх наших героїв, хто віддав своє життя, аби жила Україна, хто захистив нас і назавжди залишився в небі.

Today, the Air Force is much more than just one branch of the military. It is a component of our defense that, in many ways, truly shapes the course of this war. Ukrainians did not surrender – and will not surrender – their skies to Russia. That is one of our nation's greatest achievements throughout this full-scale war. We did not allow our Air Force to be destroyed, and have built it up to the point where Russia regularly loses its aircraft. And now, when the only thing – the last thing – Putin has left to bet on is his massive attacks against Ukraine, the Air Force, our combat aviation, is destroying Russian cruise missiles and trying to destroy ballistic missiles as well. And when our Patriot batteries aren't empty, it succeeds. It is important that, thanks to our cooperation with Europe, our IRIS-T, Hawk, and NASAMS systems are operating. Every day, we fight to secure missile supplies for them. And I am grateful that our partners around the world are helping us with that. Of course, ballistic missiles remain a challenge. But we have provided Ukraine with protection against a significant share of cruise missiles, and we are shooting down a great many. Our interception rate against attack drones is also above 90%, and that is a truly significant achievement for Ukraine – for all of us, for every one of you. I thank all of you – all those gathered here today, every man and woman defending Ukraine's skies – who, despite fighting what is, in reality, an unequal battle and lacking sufficient means to bring down enemy targets, accomplish the incredible, go beyond the maximum. You have shown the world your skill and proven that Ukrainians are capable of overcoming anything. All we need are the weapons and the means to do it. We are proud of you. And we honor all our heroes who gave their lives so that Ukraine lives – those who protected us and remain in the skies forever. Video

EL ACALORADO CRUCE ENTRE RODRIGO DE PAUL Y UNA FIGURA DE CABO VERDE EN EL EMPATE DEL INTER MIAMI POR LA MLS El fútbol no olvida, y menos cuando se vieron las caras previamente en una cita mundial. Apenas semanas después de haber disputado uno de los partidos más emocionantes en la historia moderna de los Mundiales, Rodrigo De Paul y el defensor franco-caboverdiano Steven Moreira se volvieron a ver las caras. Esta vez, el escenario no fue la eliminación directa de una Copa del Mundo, sino la fase regular de la Major League Soccer (MLS). Sin embargo, la intensidad sobre el césped demostró que la tensión nacida en Miami sigue completamente intacta. El reencuentro se dio en el marco del vibrante empate 2-2 entre el Inter Miami CF y el Columbus Crew, donde ambos futbolistas volvieron a sacarse chispas. Los videos que inundaron las redes sociales expusieron cruces verbales de alta tensión, discusiones cara a cara y un juego físico al límite que recordó de inmediato por qué estos dos atletas están en la elite de sus respectivas posiciones. El partido tuvo de todo: desde faltas tácticas de De Paul hasta un golazo de Luis Suárez desde más de 30 metros, pero el foco de atención se lo llevó la batalla personal entre el argentino y el defensor africano. 🔗infob.ae/3RO8QEV

EL ÁRTICO EN ALERTA: CÓMO SON LAS EXPEDICIONES QUE INVESTIGAN LA REGIÓN MÁS AFECTADA POR EL CALENTAMIENTO GLOBAL | Por Camila Caruso El Ártico, inhóspito y aparentemente lejano, revela señales de alarma que resuenan en todo el planeta. Mientras otras regiones observan cómo las temperaturas suben gradualmente, en estas latitudes extremas los cambios avanzan a un ritmo sin precedentes. El hielo que alguna vez cubría mares y costas durante todo el año retrocede y se fragmenta, lo que abre rutas antes imposibles y altera el equilibrio de océanos y atmósfera. Para entender lo que está ocurriendo, equipos internacionales pusieron en marcha expediciones que desafían el frío, la oscuridad y la distancia. Sus descubrimientos no solo buscan explicar por qué el Ártico se calienta más rápido que cualquier otro lugar, sino también anticipar las consecuencias de este fenómeno para la vida en la Tierra. La exploración de bases flotantes y misiones a bordo de rompehielos permite observar de cerca los detalles de un territorio donde el futuro del clima global se decide cada día. 🔗infob.ae/4qc2w7f
